disorder-name.detail: DSM-5 obsessive compulsive disorder; first-episode and untreated patients
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Atotal of ninety-eight first-episode and untreated patients diagnosed with OCD were recruited from outpatient services within the Department of Psychiatry at the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University. Diagnosis was established independently by two experienced psychiatrists in accordance with the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, Fifth Edition (DSM-5) criteria for OCD."
